ModelAnim is the first multiply-inheriting class in the tree (Model + Animation, Animation at +0x50): the animated-model base that scene objects embed as a member subobject. Copy is the first real MI argument conversion; SetAnim switches BCA files with a fast same-file path; func_020167a4 is the file-local bones-only refresh daMoray_c also calls on a BlendModelAnim*.

The fold takes the class's method run, lifecycle excluded: with no key function defined in this TU the emitted object is the seven licensed .text sections and nothing else -- no vtable group, no C2/D2 siblings, no thunks. The whole lifecycle row (D2, D0, D1, C1, C2 at 0x0201689c..0x020169d8) remains enrolled shards and the _ZThn80_ thunks remain theirs in the thunk block, the same forced split BlendModelAnim took (defining ~ModelAnim() would emit the MI vtable group whose secondary preamble cannot be licensed).
